courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: After adding maps in the last section of this course, it's now time to tap into real native device features,
so certain features that might only be supported by mobile devices or that are baked into mobile devices,
Therefore in this module, we'll have a look at how Capacitor works which is the tool we'll use for that.
Now you might remember that I introduced Capacitor earlier in this course already,
so here we'll have a brief refresher on that.
We'll then dive into using two specific Capacitor APIs and that would be the geolocation, which
allows us to get the current location of the user so that this is an alternative to picking a spot on
a map and we'll have a look at using the camera, so how we can use the device camera to take a picture.
We'll then of course also use that picture and upload it.
